title: Past Tense — Feminine & Neuter
explanation: For feminine singular subjects, the past tense endings are: -łam (ja, f), -łaś (ty, f), -ła (ona). For neuter singular subjects (ono/to): -ło. For example: robić (to do) → robiłam (I did, f), robiłaś (you did, f), robiła (she did), robiło (it did). Plural forms: masculine personal (oni) → -li; all other plurals (one/wy/my non-virile) → -ły. Example: oni robili (they did, mixed/male group), one robiły (they did, female group).

examples.english: Did you work yesterday? (addressing a female)

exercises.prompt: Which is the correct past tense form of 'pracować' for 'ja' (I, female)?
exercises.explanation: Feminine 1st person singular past: -łam ending. Pracować → pracowałam.

exercises.prompt: Complete with the past tense of 'czytać' (to read) for 'ona' (she):
exercises.explanation: Feminine 3rd person singular past: -ła ending. Czytać → czytała.

exercises.prompt: How do you say 'The children played' (dzieci = children, neuter plural → non-virile)?
exercises.explanation: 'Dzieci' is a non-virile plural noun. Non-virile plural past tense uses -ły: grały.

exercises.prompt: Complete with the past tense of 'iść' (to go) for 'ona' (she): irregular stem szła
exercises.explanation: 'Iść' has an irregular past tense. Feminine singular: szła.
3rd person feminine singular past of 'zjeść': zjadła. Options B/C are masculine forms; D is feminine 1st person.
